segments.title: Say hello in Swahili!
segments.say: Let's say hello in Swahili, with Amani from Mombasa, Kenya!

segments.title: Which one is Swahili?
segments.say: Amani says hello. Which word does she use? Three. Two. One.

segments.title: It's Jambo!
segments.source: Jambo: a friendly hello in East Africa
segments.say: It's Jambo! A friendly hello all over East Africa.

segments.title: Sound like a local
segments.say: Want to sound like a local? Ask, Habari? It means, any news? And the answer is, Nzuri. Fine!

segments.title: COMMENT BELOW
segments.say: Which word should we learn next? Comment below, and follow for a new word.
